coreCriterion.zh: 能否与外国人流畅沟通
coreCriterion.en: Can you communicate fluently with foreign speakers

fluency.descZh: 语速、停顿频率、自我修正是否自然连贯

pronunciation.descZh: 音素准确度、重音、连读与语调
pronunciation.descEn: Accuracy of sounds, stress, linking and intonation

grammarVocab.descZh: 句法正确性、词汇丰富度与地道程度
grammarVocab.descEn: Sentence accuracy, lexical range and naturalness

content.descZh: 是否切题、逻辑连贯、观点完整
content.descEn: Relevance, coherence and completeness of ideas

interaction.descZh: 回应与追问、话轮衔接、临场应变
interaction.descEn: Responding, turn-taking and managing the exchange

levels.descZh: 只能蹦出零散单词或极短句，尚无法成句沟通。
levels.descEn: Can only produce isolated words; cannot yet hold a sentence-level exchange.

levels.descZh: 能就日常熟悉话题简单对话，错误较多，常需对方迁就。
levels.descEn: Handles simple, familiar topics; frequent errors and much accommodation from the listener.

levels.descZh: 能应付旅行与工作基本交流，可表达观点，但流畅度与准确度仍不稳定。
levels.descEn: Manages basic travel and work exchanges; expresses opinions with uneven fluency.

levels.descZh: 能与外国人顺畅交流大部分话题，偶有卡顿，基本无需对方迁就。
levels.descEn: Communicates smoothly on most topics with only occasional hesitation.

levels.descZh: 表达自然流畅，能参与深入讨论，语域把握较准。
levels.descEn: Speaks naturally and fluently; engages in in-depth discussion with good register control.

levels.descZh: 接近母语者水平，表达精准、语域与修辞自然得体。
levels.descEn: Near-native: precise, idiomatic and rhetorically natural.

fluency.zh: 多做「限时连说」训练：任选一个话题连续讲 90 秒不停顿，录音后回听标记卡顿处，逐步减少 'um / 呃' 与自我更正。
fluency.en: Practise timed monologues: speak for 90 seconds without stopping, then review the recording and cut filler and self-corrections.

pronunciation.zh: 针对易错音（如 th / v / r / l 与词尾辅音）做最小对立对跟读，配合智能评测反复比对，重点练重音与句子语调。
pronunciation.en: Drill problem sounds (th / v / r / l, final consonants) with minimal-pair shadowing, focusing on stress and sentence intonation.

grammarVocab.zh: 建立「功能表达库」：把观点、举例、对比、让步各准备 2–3 个句型，练习时强制替换使用，扩大主动词汇。
grammarVocab.en: Build a bank of functional phrases (opinion, example, contrast, concession) and force yourself to rotate them to widen active vocabulary.

content.zh: 答题用「总—分—总」结构：先亮观点，再给一到两个带细节的例子，最后收一句结论，避免跑题与空洞。
content.en: Answer with a claim–support–conclusion structure: state a view, give one or two detailed examples, then close with a short conclusion.

interaction.zh: 练习「回应 + 追问」：每次回答后主动抛回一个问题，并常用 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' 等交际策略，保持对话流动。
interaction.en: Practise respond-and-ask: after each answer, ask a follow-up question and use repair phrases to keep the exchange moving.

quickMode.descZh: 快速版：约 10 分钟，听力 4 题（A2–B2）+ 口语 5 题（A1–B2），给出粗略等级。
quickMode.descEn: Quick mode: about 10 minutes, 4 listening items (A2–B2) and 5 speaking items (A1–B2), rough level.

fullMode.descZh: 完整版：约 25 分钟，全部听力与口语题型，精准评分。
fullMode.descEn: Full mode: about 25 minutes, all listening and speaking items, precise scoring.
